boundary_profiles.board_assembly_not_component_or_silicon_: Board assembly does not establish passive, connector, semiconductor, or substrate productive closure.
boundary_profiles.chemical_supply_not_purity_safety_or_aut: Chemical representation/supply does not establish purity, suitability, safe handling, environmental compliance, or authority.
boundary_profiles.component_exists_not_service_envelope_or: A component exists does not establish compatibility, operating envelope, reliability, or service capacity.
boundary_profiles.design_fab_package_board_and_service_are: Chip design, fabrication, package/test, board integration, and operational compute service are distinct evidence stages.
boundary_profiles.feedstock_not_qualified_material_propert: Mineral feedstock does not establish composition, microstructure, optical/electrical/mechanical properties, or qualification.
boundary_profiles.fit_not_function_lifetime_or_equivalence: Dimensional fit does not establish friction, sealing, fatigue, runout, lifetime, or functional equivalence.
boundary_profiles.instrument_exists_not_calibrated_current: Instrument/reading existence does not establish calibrated measurement, traceability, currentness, coverage, or independence.
boundary_profiles.inventory_not_emergency_service_readines: Emergency inventory does not establish coverage, service readiness, governance, or resilience under shocks.
boundary_profiles.machine_exists_not_productive_or_renewal: Machine/frame ownership does not establish productive capability, tooling/metrology renewal, or multi-generation precision.
boundary_profiles.manufacturing_not_clinical_or_regulatory: Health-product manufacturing does not establish clinical efficacy, sterility, diagnostic validity, regulatory approval, or service sufficiency.
boundary_profiles.material_not_sourcing_product_or_recover: Material availability does not establish sustainable sourcing, end-use suitability, product performance, or recovery yield.
boundary_profiles.material_or_cell_not_storage_safety_life: Active materials or cell assembly do not establish storage performance, safety, lifetime, or recycling closure.
boundary_profiles.materials_not_habitable_service: Materials or structures do not establish habitable/qualified building service.
boundary_profiles.materials_not_qualified_electromechanica: Conductor/magnetic material availability does not establish a qualified motor, generator, transformer, drive, or power-electronics module.
boundary_profiles.occurrence_not_recoverable_qualified_fee: Resource occurrence does not establish recoverability, reserves, economics, or qualified feedstock.
boundary_profiles.production_not_protective_hygiene_or_sup: Production does not establish protective/hygiene performance, compliance, or adequate supply.
boundary_profiles.production_not_safety_nutrition_or_conti: Production does not establish safety, nutritional sufficiency, sustainability, storage integrity, or continuity.
boundary_profiles.refined_metal_not_qualified_grade_or_com: Refined metal does not establish alloy/material state, component qualification, or fitness.
boundary_profiles.repairable_repaired_and_reproducible_are: Repairability, one successful repair, replacement availability, and local reproduction are distinct.
boundary_profiles.service_not_safety_or_capacity: Service dependency coverage does not establish safety, quality, capacity, continuity, or regulatory admission.
boundary_profiles.shell_not_building_service: Building shell does not establish HVAC, water, sanitation, electrical, appliance, or occupancy service.
boundary_profiles.waste_recyclable_recovered_and_feedstock: Collection, recyclability, recovery, reprocessing, and specification-grade secondary feedstock are distinct propositions.
